scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix website && npm install --prefix mobile
scripts.dev:mobile: cd mobile && EXPO_NO_CAPABILITY_SYNC=1 EXPO_OFFLINE=1 npx expo start --offline
scripts.dev:android: cd mobile && EXPO_NO_CAPABILITY_SYNC=1 EXPO_OFFLINE=1 npx expo start --android --offline
scripts.dev: concurrently -k --raw "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:website" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n backend,website -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:website"
scripts.build:backend: npm run build --prefix backend 2>/dev/null || echo 'Backend build skipped'
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:website
